description: Rigorous specification for F5 compact equilibrium configuration with continuous still-water free surface up to shoreline x=24/7, submerged weir exclusion, proven full drawmode syntax, and 17g exclusive IO.

continuum_equilibrium_mass_and_volume.mass_normalization_policy: forbidden - discrete particles carry native mass mp = rho0 * dp^3; no mass scaling or normalizing to 325.714 kg
continuum_equilibrium_mass_and_volume.retraction_statement: Explicitly retracts provisional 043 assumptions of 240.0 kg flat-only fluid mass and 30000/122880/240000 provisional fluid counts. Flat fluid truncated at x=2.0 m created an unphysical vertical water face at t=0 that collapsed downslope immediately.

syntax_and_source_pins.drawmode_declaration_policy: Single <setdrawmode mode="full" /> declared at the beginning of commands/mainlist; zero mode="solid" entries.
syntax_and_source_pins.motion_source_pin_justification: JMotion.cpp lines 814-826 explicitly group 'else if(name=="mvpredef" || name=="mvfile" || name=="mvrectfile")' identically, calling MovAddRectilinearFile with identical parameter parsing. mvpredef is a fully verified, accepted alias.

fluid_lattice_generation.bed_support_policy: Source-first bed boundary support and finite tank/piston drawn before fluid.
fluid_lattice_generation.native_fill_precedence: Boundary particles rasterized first prevent fluid overwrite on bed, walls, and weir solids.

explicit_clipplane.purpose: Clips fluid box strictly above continuous bed slope and below SWL H=0.400 m up to shoreline x=24/7.

post_gencase_asset_protection.policy: sourceasset postGen copying required because actual F7 GenCase erased declared motion file to 0 bytes

weir_structure.description: 3D notched weir on slope with central notch for candidate shallow overtopping and lateral shoulders retaining/reflecting fluid.

resolutions_ladder.comparison_policy: Independent reference ladder .02/.0125/.01 is direct unequal-r comparisons without Richardson extrapolation assumptions.

dp020.pointref_y_alignment: centered on W=0.30m (odd cell count 15: cell center at y=0)

dp0125.pointref_y_alignment: centered on W=0.30m (even cell count 24: cell interface at y=0, centers at +-0.00625)

dp010.pointref_y_alignment: centered on W=0.30m (even cell count 30: cell interface at y=0, centers at +-0.005)

observer_specification.geometry_policy: Probes local bed true elevation: point0.z = z_bed(x) to prevent sub-bed embedding and false 1.5H floor step jumps.

control.reflection_note: Analytic finite envelope does NOT eliminate wavemaker reflections/chaos; return stationary paddle at x=0 reflects returning waves
